description: HCP Backup and Restore user-journey SLO dashboard (ARO-29950).

options.content:
### HCP Backup & Restore SLO Dashboard

User-journey dashboard for Velero-managed HCP backups on management clusters. Baseline panels follow **ARO-29950** and mirror the current SLO/alert thresholds from **ARO-29948 / ARO-26261**.

| SLI | Dashboard interpretation | Objective / threshold |
|-----|---------------------------|-----------------------|
| **Availability** | 6-hourly backup freshness per HostedCluster (daily/weekly freshness only in the per-HCP table below) | `userJourneyBackupAvailability` fires at **13h / 49h / 337h** (6-hourly/daily/weekly); `userJourneyBackupNeverSucceeded` fires at **12h / 48h / 336h** (single tier each, no escalation) |
| **Errors** | failed completed outcomes / all completed outcomes | **< 0.5%** failures / **99.5%** success over 30d |
| **Latency** | completed backup duration p50/p95/p99 | **p99 < 20m** |
| **Traffic** | backup attempt rate vs 1d baseline | no sustained drop below **10%** of baseline |
| **Saturation** | non-terminal backup backlog + data-upload health | informational only - no backing alert |

**Scope:** Prometheus service datasources and management clusters. Selecting an HCP Namespace scopes Availability / Errors / Latency / Traffic. Storage Availability and Saturation stay management-cluster-wide because those are fleet proxy signals.

**Known gaps:** Storage Availability and repo-maintenance Saturation are proxy signals pending ARO-29949. Snapshot-specific panels wait for ARO-29444. Restore SLIs are deferred until restore activity is exercised and instrumented. Visibility into paused backup schedules (Schedule `spec.pause` via KSM, so a paused HC doesn't look stale) is also tracked under ARO-29949. In prod, `velero_backup_last_successful_timestamp`, `velero_backup_duration_seconds_*` and `velerobackup_phase` are currently only emitted in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South, so the freshness, latency and backlog panels will be blank in other regions until those metrics ship fleet-wide.

**Runbook / TSG:** [aka.ms/arohcp-runbook-backup](https://aka.ms/arohcp-runbook-backup) | **Jira:** [ARO-29950](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/ARO-29950)

**Drilldown:** use the HCP Namespace selector and the per-HCP tables at the bottom. Component-level details remain in the existing Velero dashboard (`ozk-vlr-mon`).

panels.description: Percent of selected 6-hourly HCP schedules whose last successful backup is no more than 12 hours old. Operational target: 100%. Only populated in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South today; blank in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide.
panels.title: Freshness Coverage (≤12h)

panels.description: Maximum age of the last successful 6-hourly backup among selected HCPs. Red threshold mirrors the single-tier 13h userJourneyBackupAvailability6Hourly alert (no 24h/72h escalation tier). Only populated in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South today; blank in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide.
panels.title: Worst Backup Age

panels.description: Completed-outcome success rate over the last 30 days. SLO target: ≥99.5%.

targets.expr: (1-(((sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_partial_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_validation_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0)))/((sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_success_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_partial_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_validation_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[30d]))) or vector(0)))))*100

panels.title: 30d Backup Success Rate

panels.description: Remaining 0.5% failure budget over 30 days. 100% means no budget consumed; 0% means exhausted.

panels.title: Backup Error Rate (0.5% SLO)

panels.description: p99 completed-backup duration over the selected dashboard range. SLO target: <20 minutes. Only populated in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South today; blank in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide.
panels.title: Backup Latency p99

panels.description: Current attempt rate. Six-hourly schedules are synchronized, so zero between cadence bursts is normal.
panels.title: Backup Attempt Rate (5m)

panels.description: 12h average attempt rate as a percentage of the 1-day average. Alert threshold is <10% sustained for 1h.

targets.expr: 100 * avg_over_time((sum by (cluster) (max without (prometheus_replica) (rate(velero_backup_attempt_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[5m]))))[12h:5m]) / avg_over_time((sum by (cluster) (max without (prometheus_replica) (rate(velero_backup_attempt_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[5m]))))[1d:5m])

panels.description: Successful + failed + partial-failed + validation-failed backups in the selected time range.

targets.expr: round((sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_success_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[$__range]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[$__range]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_partial_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[$__range]))) or vector(0))+(sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(velero_backup_validation_failure_total{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~"${hcp_namespace:regex}-(6-hourly|daily|weekly)"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)))

panels.description: Completed backup duration percentiles. Red target line at 1200s (20m). Only populated in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South today; blank in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide.
panels.title: Backup Latency p50 / p95 / p99 (20m SLO)

panels.description: Backup attempt rate over time. Expect synchronized bursts near each six-hourly cadence tick.
panels.title: Backup Attempt Rate

panels.description: Percent of 6-hourly schedules whose most recent run failed - a secondary/legacy proxy hint, not what userJourneyBackupStorageAvailability alerts on (see 'Default Storage Location Availability' in the Storage Availability & Saturation row above for the primary signal, which checks velero_backup_location_status_gauge directly). HostedCluster count is shown alongside for context.

targets.expr: 100*((count by (cluster) (max without (prometheus_replica) (velero_backup_last_status{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~".+-6-hourly"}) == 0) or 0 * count by (cluster) (max without (prometheus_replica) (velero_backup_last_status{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~".+-6-hourly"})))/count by (cluster) (max without (prometheus_replica) (velero_backup_last_status{cluster="$cluster", schedule=~".+-6-hourly"})))

panels.title: Storage Failure Proxy

panels.description: Current count of backups in non-terminal phases. Informational only - no backing alert. Only populated in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South today; blank in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide.
panels.title: Non-terminal Backup Backlog

panels.description: PodVolume data-upload failure share in the selected dashboard time range.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(podvolume_data_upload_failure_total{cluster="$cluster"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / (((sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(podvolume_data_upload_success_total{cluster="$cluster"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) + (sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(podvolume_data_upload_failure_total{cluster="$cluster"}[$__range]))) or vector(0))) > 0))

panels.title: Data Upload Failure Rate

panels.description: Total successful, failed and cancelled PodVolume data-upload operations in the selected time range.

targets.expr: round((sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(podvolume_data_upload_success_total{cluster="$cluster"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) + (sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(podvolume_data_upload_failure_total{cluster="$cluster"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) + (sum(max without (prometheus_replica) (increase(podvolume_data_upload_cancel_total{cluster="$cluster"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Data Upload Operations

panels.description: Management-cluster backlog of queued/in-progress/finalizing backups. Red line at 10. Only populated in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South today; blank in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide.
panels.title: Non-terminal Backup Backlog Over Time

panels.description: Node-agent PodVolume upload outcomes per hour. Use with backlog to distinguish data-movement pressure from ordinary backup failures.
panels.title: Data Upload Operations per Hour

panels.description: Hourly PodVolume data-upload outcomes per node-agent node. This is the per-node saturation/drilldown view requested by ARO-29950.
panels.title: Data Upload Outcomes per Node

panels.description: Hours since the last successful backup for schedules belonging to the selected HCP namespace. Only populated in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South today; blank in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide.
panels.title: Hours Since Last Successful Backup

panels.description: Latest Velero backup status for schedules belonging to the selected HCP namespace (1=Success, 0=Failure).
panels.title: Backup Schedule Last Status

panels.description: Velero's own velero_backup_location_status_gauge for the default BackupStorageLocation (1=Available, 0=Unavailable). Primary storage-availability signal, matching what userJourneyBackupStorageAvailability alerts on directly; the 'Storage Failure Proxy' panel further down in Extended Signals (last-run-failure ratio + HC count) remains a secondary hint.
panels.title: Default Storage Location Availability

panels.description: Count by cluster of recurring-cadence schedules (6-hourly/daily/weekly) that have reported a status but never a successful-backup timestamp - the same 'unless' condition backing userJourneyBackupNeverSucceeded. These are the schedules clamped to 168h in the age panels above. Only populated in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South today; blank in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide.
panels.title: Backup Schedules Never Succeeded

panels.description: Current count of key-rotation Backup CRs (name matching <namespace>-keyrotation-<fingerprint>) whose velerobackup_phase is Failed/PartiallyFailed/FailedValidation right now - this is current CR state, not a selected-range count, since key is name (not schedule): key-rotation backups are one-off, triggered by KMS key rotation, not tied to a Schedule object, and are not retried if they fail - deliberately excluded from the recurring-cadence SLI panels above, so tracked here instead. Only populated in Australia East, East US 2 EUAP and UK South today; blank in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide.
panels.title: Current Key-Rotation Backups in Failure Phase

panels.description: Failed Velero DeleteBackupRequests (velero_backup_deletion_failure_total) in the selected time range - same metric already used in the existing Velero component dashboard (ozk-vlr-mon). A sustained non-zero count means orphaned backups are piling up because cleanup keeps failing.
panels.title: Backup Deletion Failures (range)

panels.description: EXPLORATORY: velero_repo_maintenance_failure_total would back Saturation better than the Non-terminal Backup Backlog proxy above, and is confirmed live in prod - but so far only in Australia East and UK South, so it will show 'No data' in other regions until the metric ships fleet-wide. velero_repo_maintenance_duration_seconds is not yet confirmed. Keeping this EXPLORATORY rather than promoting it to the primary saturation signal until coverage is fleet-wide.
panels.title: Repo Maintenance Failures (EXPLORATORY - unverified in prod)
